# Terrace: a paved stone terrace 17 x 7 m (top at z 0) on a mountain top, moss at its edges, four
# steps down the front, a rough cliff cone under it that sinks into the clouds. Generated by
# make_env.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Paving --base-color 0.1451 0.3020 0.4392 --no-slot
material new Moss --base-color 0.3216 0.7647 0.2471 --no-slot
material new Rock --base-color 0.1451 0.1412 0.2745 --no-slot
material new Path --base-color 0.0863 0.4314 0.4784 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Top --size 1 --location 0 0 -0.5
scale 17 7 1
apply --scale
material assign Rock
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
subdivide --cuts 16
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
material assign Paving
select face where "normal.z > 0.9 && pos.x > -1.6 && pos.x < 1.6"
material assign Path
select face where "normal.z > 0.9 && (((pos.x - (-6.57))*(pos.x - (-6.57)) + (pos.y - (-2.22))*(pos.y - (-2.22)) < 0.444) || ((pos.x - (6.69))*(pos.x - (6.69)) + (pos.y - (-2.61))*(pos.y - (-2.61)) < 0.093) || ((pos.x - (5.41))*(pos.x - (5.41)) + (pos.y - (-1.59))*(pos.y - (-1.59)) < 0.488) || ((pos.x - (6.39))*(pos.x - (6.39)) + (pos.y - (0.30))*(pos.y - (0.30)) < 0.211) || ((pos.x - (-5.31))*(pos.x - (-5.31)) + (pos.y - (-2.09))*(pos.y - (-2.09)) < 0.449) || ((pos.x - (7.09))*(pos.x - (7.09)) + (pos.y - (1.03))*(pos.y - (1.03)) < 0.106) || ((pos.x - (-5.55))*(pos.x - (-5.55)) + (pos.y - (-2.81))*(pos.y - (-2.81)) < 0.418) || ((pos.x - (6.58))*(pos.x - (6.58)) + (pos.y - (2.52))*(pos.y - (2.52)) < 0.207) || ((pos.x - (5.88))*(pos.x - (5.88)) + (pos.y - (1.81))*(pos.y - (1.81)) < 0.228) || ((pos.x - (-7.58))*(pos.x - (-7.58)) + (pos.y - (-2.42))*(pos.y - (-2.42)) < 0.126) || ((pos.x - (-5.40))*(pos.x - (-5.40)) + (pos.y - (1.03))*(pos.y - (1.03)) < 0.374) || ((pos.x - (5.97))*(pos.x - (5.97)) + (pos.y - (2.00))*(pos.y - (2.00)) < 0.280) || ((pos.x - (6.54))*(pos.x - (6.54)) + (pos.y - (2.43))*(pos.y - (2.43)) < 0.328) || ((pos.x - (-7.50))*(pos.x - (-7.50)) + (pos.y - (2.95))*(pos.y - (2.95)) < 0.323) || ((pos.x - (-6.95))*(pos.x - (-6.95)) + (pos.y - (-1.04))*(pos.y - (-1.04)) < 0.267) || ((pos.x - (-7.00))*(pos.x - (-7.00)) + (pos.y - (-1.73))*(pos.y - (-1.73)) < 0.400))"
material assign Moss
mode object
add mesh cube --name Step0 --size 1 --location 0 -3.775 -0.950
scale 4.80 0.55 1.300
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Step1 --size 1 --location 0 -4.325 -1.100
scale 5.40 0.55 1.000
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Step2 --size 1 --location 0 -4.875 -1.250
scale 6.00 0.55 0.700
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Step3 --size 1 --location 0 -5.425 -1.400
scale 6.60 0.55 0.400
apply --scale
select Step0 Step1 Step2 Step3
material assign Paving
add mesh cone --name Cliff --vertices 12 --radius1 9.6 --radius2 4.0 --depth 5.5 --location 0 0 -3.75 --rotation 180 0 0
apply --rotation
scale 1 0.55 1
apply --scale
material assign Rock
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
select vert where "pos.z < -1.2"
randomize --amount 0.5 --seed 4
mode object
select Top Cliff Step0 Step1 Step2 Step3
active Top
join
shade flat
export terrace.glb
